hero.headline: Building Excellence Across the Seas.
hero.description: Pioneering state-of-the-art superyacht manufacturing, precision commercial vessel construction, and bespoke naval engineering. Operating from world-class shipyard facilities in Tuzla, Türkiye, we combine centuries of maritime craftsmanship with cutting-edge hydrodynamics.

stats.capabilityDesc: Modern covered shipyard drydocks & assembly halls in Tuzla.
stats.integrationDesc: Full lifecycle naval architecture, structural CFD & marine design.
stats.heritageDesc: Continuous maritime heritage delivering sovereign luxury flagships.
stats.complianceDesc: Rigid global quality metrics aligned with Lloyd's Register & DNV.

home.craftedDesc: Comprehensive turnkey shipyard solutions from initial hydrodynamic lofting to final sovereign ocean handover.
home.infraDesc: Located in Istanbul's historic maritime gateway of Tuzla, our shipyard facilities integrate heavy industrial lifting capabilities with dust-controlled finishing clean-rooms.
home.gantryDesc: Multi-block module consolidation and safe hull turning.
home.drydockDesc: Year-round climate stabilization for hull painting and outfitting.
home.cfdDesc: Numerical wave pattern testing and drag coefficient simulations.
home.classDesc: Permanent surveyor inspection stations for Lloyd's, ABS, & RINA.
home.ctaDesc: Whether preparing a technical tender for a specialized commercial fleet or commissioning a bespoke 70-meter tri-deck mega-yacht, our master naval architects will guide you through engineering specifications, shipyard drydock slots, and project timelines.

about.eyebrow: Maritime Heritage & Sovereign Craftsmanship • Est. Tuzla, Türkiye
about.headline: A Century of European Shipbuilding Mastery, Engineered for Tomorrow’s Oceans
about.description: Positioned where East Mediterranean naval lineage converges with precision German-Dutch hydrodynamic computational modeling. Royal Caribbean Shipbuilding designs and fabricates sovereign patrol vessels, custom 60m+ mega-yachts, and low-emission commercial cruise liners built to endure unyielding global waters.
about.standardsDesc: Vessels engineered under the Royal Caribbean standard are conceived as multi-generational marine assets. We do not accommodate shortcut metallurgy or algorithmic approximations.
about.leadershipDesc: Our senior board unites international classification society veterans, naval hydrodynamics researchers, and artisanal superyacht cabinetmakers.
about.tourDesc: Prospective vessel owners, family office representatives, and naval procurement attachés are cordially invited to inspect active construction blocks, review wet-basin CFD test tanks, and meet directly with the naval design bureau.

services.title: Master Naval Architecture & Turnkey Marine Engineering
services.desc: From initial conceptual sketches and supercomputing CFD hydrodynamics to high-tensile structural steel fabrication and whisper-quiet hybrid propulsion integration, Royal Caribbean delivers bespoke engineering rigor across custom mega-yachts, specialized commercial vessels, and comprehensive refits.
services.matrixDesc: Fully integrated naval engineering, fabrication, and refit protocols governed by internationally recognized classification societies.
services.studyDesc: Our Chief Naval Architect and technical directors are available for consultations regarding new builds, complex refits, or computational hull hydrodynamics.

projects.headline: An Enduring Fleet of Naval Masterpieces
projects.desc: Explore custom mega-yachts, expedition cruisers, commercial catamarans, and specialized maritime vessels engineered at our Tuzla shipyard to Lloyd’s Register, RINA, and DNV standards.

shipyard.headline: World-Class Naval Infrastructure & Precision Drydock Facilities
shipyard.desc: Spanning 185,000 square metres of pristine Tuzla waterfront, our compound seamlessly converges historic European naval craftsmanship with Mediterranean high-displacement civil and superyacht shipbuilding power.
shipyard.tourDesc: Tour our covered building bays, inspect resident metallurgy labs, and discuss drydock slot availability with our Yard Operations Director under full NDA.

process.headline: The 9-Stage Naval Construction Process
process.desc: Trace the exact journey of our naval commissions from initial virtual tank computational hydrodynamics to owner registry flag hoisting.

news.headline: Naval Intelligence & Shipyard Dispatches
news.desc: Chronicles from the slipways of Tuzla: maiden sea trials, hydrodynamics whitepapers, Lloyd's Register class milestones, and next-generation naval architecture.

contact.headline: Initiate a Direct Inquiry with Tuzla Yard Command
contact.desc: Whether booking a drydock reservation, submitting a commercial fleet tender, or commissioning a custom mega-yacht, our naval architecture bureau and project directors respond promptly under full bilateral NDA.
